source.snippet: Hard req: has to have cell connectivity & support roaming (US <> EU). Not for daily use, but for comms when they're out of the house in case they need to reach out. I looked at apple watch family and it's great, except that it doesn't allow roaming or plans abroad (it seems that BetterRoaming might work but it's unclear). The Garmin Bounce 2 looks like it fits the bill, but it has ZERO reviews and some comments make it look like it's crap. The Light Phone III...

problem_statement: Parents cannot find a reliable semi-dumb phone or watch for kids that supports international roaming across US and EU, leaving a gap between full smartphones and non-roaming wearables.
target_segment: Parents of school-age children who travel internationally or split time between US and EU
notes: Explicit buyer intent: parent actively shopping, has evaluated Apple Watch Family, Garmin Bounce 2, Light Phone III. Willing to pay for a hardware/plan solution. Market gap is roaming support combined with limited functionality. Could be a reseller/MVNO play or curated hardware + plan bundle.
